definitions.explanation: Related to environmental conservation or products that are good for the environment.

examples.japanese: エコな{生活|せいかつ}を{心|こころ}がけている。
examples.english: I try to live an eco-friendly lifestyle.

examples.japanese: エコバッグを{持参|じさん}する。
examples.english: I bring my own eco bag.

examples.japanese: エコカーに{乗|の}り{換|か}えた。
examples.english: I switched to an eco-friendly car.

notes:
エコ is short for エコロジー (ecology). It functions as a prefix meaning "eco-friendly" and is extremely common in modern Japanese marketing and daily life.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- エコバッグ: reusable shopping bag (very common since Japan's plastic bag charge in 2020)
- エコカー: eco-friendly car (hybrid/electric)
- エコ{活動|かつどう}: eco activities, green initiatives
- エコ{商品|しょうひん}: eco-friendly products
- エコポイント: eco points (government incentive program)

GRAMMAR:
Can be used as a na-adjective modifier: エコな{生活|せいかつ} (eco-friendly lifestyle), エコな{選択|せんたく} (eco-friendly choice).

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {環境|かんきょう}にやさしい: environmentally friendly (more formal)
- グリーン: green (as in green energy, green initiatives)
- サステナブル: sustainable
